notes:
**Notes for "Do the Raptors play tonight?" (today is Monday, Oct 12, 2026). I assumed the Toronto Raptors of the NBA, since the question names no league.**

- The Raptors do not appear to play on Monday, Oct 12. Their preseason slate has no game on that date.
  - The ESPN schedule lists a game on Saturday, Oct 10, a Raptors win over the Clippers, 114–106. The next game it lists is Tuesday, Oct 13 vs New York at 7:00 PM.
  - The NBA.com schedule agrees. It lists Oct 10 vs LAC, then Oct 13 vs NYK at Scotiabank Arena, with nothing in between.
- The next game is Tuesday, Oct 13. The Knicks and Raptors meet in the NBA preseason, with tipoff at 7:00 p.m. ET at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto.
  - Yahoo Sports/Action Network says it will be broadcast live on Sportsnet.
  - Sports Media Watch lists NBA League Pass, plus Sportsnet and Sportsnet+ for the home broadcast.
- After that, the next preseason game is at the Knicks on Thu, Oct 15, at Madison Square Garden. Then comes a game at Detroit on Oct 16 at 7:00 pm ET.
- The regular season opens at home against the Chicago Bulls on Oct. 21.
- Some sources conflict on the regular-season start. USA Today (via Yahoo) says Oct. 20. The Raptors' own schedule, covered by Raptors Republic and NBA.com, has them opening Oct 21.
- Several pages were already showing the Oct 13 game as a completed result, even though that is after the stated date. I did not rely on those.
